items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] The book by David Meeker called Jazz At The Movies... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, well I really wouldn't know. I've forgotten.

ctx.x:
Yeah, that was really something.

The funny thing about that, I had forgotten all about 'Stop, You're Breaking My Heart' completely.

It was one of the selections we did on that first record date that I made when I first came to New York.

And when my son played it for me a couple of months ago, I listened to the arrangement and it sounded familiar. And I couldn't figure it out quite completely.

And then, when the vocal started, I feel like Bernice did just a while ago, 'That's me!'
Yeah. You were telling us about that (inaudible).
We also stumbled across something that's very interesting. The book by David Meeker called Jazz At The Movies, published in 1977.
